label: I q.9 a.1 co. and ad 1 — Whatever undergoes change is in potency in some way
locator: I q.9 a.1 co. and ad 1
interpretation: The first reason for divine immutability requires potency in what changes. Ad 1 distinguishes change of a subject in potency from a broader use of motion for immanent operations such as understanding and willing.
attribution: The passage states that whatever undergoes change in any way is in potency in some way, which is the premise.
